dct_description_sm:
This data is only available to ministries of the Ontario Public Service (OPS) and their agencies, boards and commissions. By obtaining the imagery data described in this record, you accept the terms outlined in the Memorandum of Restricted Imagery Use.
 
For more information and to order imagery products please refer to the Imagery Order Form.

 
The City of Kingston orthophotography was collected by First Base Solutions Inc. in 2011 under contract with the City. The Province of Ontario does not distribute this data to the general public.
  • Time of Capture: Spring 2011
  • Coverage: Approximately 651 sq km
  • Canopy Coverage: Leaf-Off

 
Available Products
Orthorectified Tiles – 1km x 1km, 20 cm, 8-bit, RGB in .TIFF format (approx. 72MB/tile) and a compressed format (approx. 1.05 MB/tile)
  • City of Kingston 2011 - Ortho Index (Shapefile)
  • Imagery Order Form (.docx)
     
  • Imagery User Guide (.docx)
     
Status
 
Completed: Production of the data has been completed
 
 
Maintenance and Update Frequency
 
Not planned: There are no plans to update the data
 
 
Contact
 
Ontario Ministry of Natural Resources - Geospatial Services, imagery@ontario.ca
dct_rights_sm: MINISTRY OF NATURAL RESOURCES AND FORESTRY IMAGERY INTERNAL END USER AGREEMENT FOR RESTRICTED DATA PURPOSE The purpose of this MOU is to provide internal employees (the “End User”) with access to licensed imagery products as required to complete duties that may arise in the course of their employment with the Ontario Public Service (OPS). “Imagery” refers to orthophotography, satellite-based imagery, stereo imagery products and any associated or supporting products accompanying this agreement. “Restricted” refers to data or information where the Ontario Government does not own the intellectual property. The MNRF agrees to provide the End User with the licensed products according to the following terms. TERMS Acceptance of the licensed products from the provider (Ministry of Natural Resources and Forestry) indicates the End User’s understanding of and consent to the terms of this agreement. The End User agrees that the licensed products will not be used for any purpose(s) other than those which are identified by the provider in the Ontario Ministry of Natural Resources and Forestry Electronic End User License Agreement and this Ministry of Natural Resources and Forestry Imagery Internal End User Agreement for Restricted Data. The End User agrees that the licensed products are not to be distributed externally for any purpose. The End User agrees that the licensed products are not to be distributed internally to other OPS staff unless prior approval has been granted by the provider.
